name: Click Therapeutics Clickotine
one_liner: Smartphone quit-smoking program from Click Therapeutics with a personalized plan, coaching messages and nicotine replacement, offered through sponsors.
best_for: Smokers whose employer, health plan or program partner offers Clickotine
People who want an app-based quit plan with nicotine replacement included
not_for: Anyone in crisis: call or text 988
People who want to sign up on their own: access is through a sponsoring program
People who need prescription stop-smoking medication (see a clinician, or call 1-800-QUIT-NOW)
short_description: Clickotine is an 8-week app-based smoking cessation program with personalized messages and nicotine replacement, offered through sponsors.
long_description: Clickotine is a non-prescription smoking cessation program from Click Therapeutics. Over 8 weeks the app sets a quit plan, sends personalized messages, offers breathing exercises and distractions for cravings, tracks progress and, in its program version, includes nicotine replacement therapy (patch, gum or lozenge). It is offered to members of sponsoring programs, such as employers and the youturn platform; the app listing says program members should download it. Click's focus has shifted to prescription digital therapeutics. The main published study is a 2017 single-arm trial of 416 smokers; no randomized trial has been published.
patient_summary: Clickotine is an 8-week app that helps you quit smoking with a personalized plan, craving tools and nicotine replacement. You can only use it if your employer, health plan or another program gives you access. If you don't have access, 1-800-QUIT-NOW offers free quit support.

pricing.starting_price: Free through a sponsoring employer or health plan
pricing.notes: No individual purchase found; the program is paid for by sponsors.

privacy.notes: Policy (read 2026-10-27) says it does not let third parties track you across other sites and lists only service providers, sponsors, buyers of the business and consented sharing, but never states outright whether it sells data; account and record deletion on request.

seo.title: Clickotine: Digital Smoking Cessation App | HeyPsych
seo.meta_description: Clickotine by Click Therapeutics helps patients quit smoking with personalized behavior modification, breathing exercises, live coaching, and AI-driven support.

faqs.a: Clickotine is a digital therapeutic app for smoking cessation that combines controlled breathing exercises, personalized messaging, social support, and optional live coaching to help users quit smoking.
Clickotine uses Clickometrics, a machine learning platform that analyzes user profile, motivations, and daily schedules to optimize and personalize the program for each individual.

No, Clickotine is marketed as a wellness product and did not require FDA regulatory clearance. Click Therapeutics' prescription digital therapeutics (CT-152 for MDD, CT-155 for schizophrenia) follow the FDA regulatory pathway.

Clickotine includes controlled breathing exercises, personalized text messaging, social support, medication adherence tools, financial incentives, digital diversions, live coaching, and access to nicotine replacement therapy.

clinical_trials.study: 8-week single-arm trial of Clickotine in adult smokers (NCT02656745)

citation.authors: Iacoviello BM, Steinerman JR, Klein DB, Silver TL, Berger AG, Luo SX, Schork NJ
citation.title: Clickotine, A Personalized Smartphone App for Smoking Cessation: Initial Evaluation

clinical_trials.outcome: 45.2% reported 7-day and 26.2% 30-day abstinence at 8 weeks (self-report); authors call for a randomized trial.

primary_uses: Craving management with breathing exercises and distractions
Nicotine replacement therapy within the program

availability.note: Only for members of sponsoring programs (employers, plans, partners such as youturn).
